name: ProductLaunchTemplate
summary: Complete photo-free Hahlex product landing page alternating all 6 Composition Patterns (Spatial Stage -> Editorial Split -> Interactive Showcase -> Bento Mosaic -> Workflow Loop -> Metric Mirror -> FAQ -> Espresso CTA + Top-Level Footer).
usageGuidelines: Demonstrates diverse section rhythm without repeating two identical layouts consecutively.
Never requires stock photos or scroll-jacking to look finished.
responsiveBehavior: Full responsive flow from 375px mobile to 1440px wide desktop with semantic top-level <main> and <footer>.

name: EditorialFeatureTemplate
summary: Editorial capability deep-dive page combining Monumental Typographic Poster, Architectural Visible-Rule Grid, Editorial Essay Split, and PaperTear Espresso CTA.
usageGuidelines: Best for technical launches, platform architecture pages, and narrative feature essays.
responsiveBehavior: Fluid editorial grids and 65ch reading columns across all breakpoints.

name: DirectoryWorkspaceTemplate
summary: Canonical operational directory screen: AppShell -> PageHeader (<=1 Primary CTA) -> immediate FilterBar -> Zero-Scrollbar DataTable.
usageGuidelines: Never wrap the main DataTable inside an outer Card with a redundant heading.
responsiveBehavior: Sidebar navigation + fluid table frame on desktop; filter pills wrap cleanly on mobile.

name: AnalyticsDashboardTemplate
summary: 1-Glance operational health dashboard combining AppShell, PageHeader, full-box Stat KPI tiles with tabular-nums, and semantic Alert status banner.
usageGuidelines: Limit top KPI row to 3-4 high-signal metrics with solid progress bars (zero gradients).
responsiveBehavior: Auto-fits KPI row cleanly from 3 columns down to 1 column on phones.
